overview.description: The ProShares UltraPro Short S&P500 (SPXU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund provides (-3x) exposure to a market-cap weighted index of 500 large- and mid-cap US companies selected by the S&P Committee. SPXU was launched on Jun 25, 2009 and is issued by ProShares.
